datasheet_identity.title: B5817W THRU B5819W SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 matches the expected hash 3d1e9091ea2c54fe73676fd95c6d24a4678a2b33e211f482b95dfec961baac1d.
B5818W values were selected from the B5817W/B5818W/B5819W family tables; maximum ratings are stated for Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified.

Forward voltage table values are maximum limits at the stated currents. The plotted forward curve is a typical family curve and is not individually keyed by part number; only the visible Ta = 25 degC branch was digitized.

The plotted reverse curve is a typical family curve and is not individually keyed by part number; only the visible Ta = 25 degC branch was digitized. Reverse current polarity is cathode positive relative to anode.
The plotted capacitance curve is the visible typical Ta = 25 degC, f = 1 MHz curve. Its source axis is in pF; extracted values are converted to SI unit F.
The 100 degC IR2 row was not used as a 25 degC fit input.
No reverse recovery time or reverse breakdown voltage/current specification is published in the supplied datasheet. VRRM/VDC are ratings, not breakdown measurements.
extraction.omission_reason: No reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-voltage/current specifications were published. The three plotted characteristics are usable typical curves, but the forward and reverse plots are family curves not individually keyed to B5818W.
